RESTAURANT & SHIFT WELLNESS

Designed for hospitality stamina.

Standing for hours on hard kitchen tile or carrying trays creates specific postural fatigue. Our sessions restore rotational balance and joint mobility.

Focus 1
Postural reset

Decompress hips, lower back, and shoulders after long periods on your feet.

Focus 2
Mental calm

Transition out of fast-paced restaurant rush into quiet, total physical focus.

Focus 3
Train with care

Cooperative, coached partner drills with friendly teammates at your tempo.

Focus 4
Shift-friendly

Coordinate with Sandy around prep days, split shifts, or closing schedules.

STAFF PASS PROGRAM

Ask Sandy about the offer.

Current rates and pass terms are confirmed directly with Sandy before you start, providing flexibility for hospitality shift workers.

SHIFT TIMING & CLASSES

See the current schedule.

Adult classes run weeknights at 6:00 PM and Saturday mornings at 10:30 AM. Check the live calendar or text Sandy to plan around diner shifts.
